loading.reason: Posts are read from a build-time snapshot and rendered statically; there is no client fetch, so no pending state ever reaches a visitor.

error.reason: A failed or malformed feed never reaches the page: the sync keeps the last good snapshot and a missing or corrupt snapshot reads as no posts, which is the empty state.

key-interaction.reason: The only interaction is following a link out to Substack; there is no in-page state change to capture.

empty.reason: Every book page belongs to a published entry with a required title, so a header with no book cannot be rendered.

many.reason: The header always shows exactly one book.

loading.reason: Static pre-rendered page; library entries are read at build time, so there is no pending state.

error.reason: No runtime fetch can fail; an invalid library entry fails the build instead of reaching a visitor.

key-interaction.reason: The header has no interactive controls.

loading.reason: static pre-rendered page; all data is read at build time, so there is no pending state

error.reason: no runtime fetch can fail; a malformed settings.json fails the build, and unknown paths go to the separate 404 route

empty.reason: A card is only rendered for an existing library entry, which always has a title.

many.reason: A card shows exactly one book; many books are the LibraryGrid and LibrarySection scenarios.
